description: Use https://github.com/yatish27/shore as the initial Rails template to avoid inventing boilerplate. Adapt testing from Minitest to RSpec + FactoryBot.
title: Use Shore Rails template and adapt it for RSpec

description: Run the app locally through Docker Compose and an existing external Caddy proxy network. App should be reachable via job-tracker.home.br11k.dev, not direct exposed ports.
title: Localhost deployment via Caddy reverse proxy and Docker Compose

description: Development workflow assumes coherence-core-db is installed and can run catalog preflight and DB ping via socket.
title: Coherence DB/project must be provisioned and available from host

description: Use model specs/ACs to define valid business objects. Prefer RSpec + FactoryBot for Rails app behavior. Very small pure Ruby unit tests may use Minitest only if intentionally isolated and documented.
title: Testing strategy uses RSpec/FactoryBot and Coherence specs

description: Source represents a provider of seed job/company data. It contains name, type, base_url, adapter, auth_mode, and enabled. FetchRun records adapter execution attempts for a source, including retry count, status, and JSON content containing evidence or captured errors.
title: Source and fetch run

description: Company stores organizations discovered from sources or manually added. It links to the source that introduced it and stores website and careers page URL.
title: Company

description: Resume stores structured JSON plus optional PDF location or blob reference. Resume is used when generating application drafts and submit payloads.
title: Resume

description: Experience stores a work-history entry extracted from a resume or entered manually.
title: Experience

description: ResumeExperience connects Resume rows to parsed Experience rows.
title: Resume experience link

description: Skill stores normalized capability names and their type, such as programming_language, framework, library, technology, concern, or service.
title: Skill

description: ExperienceSkill connects Experience rows to Skill rows.
title: Experience skill link

description: ExperienceStory stores STAR-style examples linked to an Experience.
title: Experience story

description: Question stores reusable applicant questions discovered during job research or manually added.
title: Question

description: QuestionResponse stores draft or approved answer material for a Question.
title: Question response

description: Job stores a normalized job posting from a source. It links to Source and Company and tracks application URL, apply adapter, skip reason, timestamps, and status.
title: Job

description: JobSkill links jobs to mentioned or required skills.
title: Job skill link

description: JobQuestion links jobs to questions discovered during research or application preparation.
title: Job question link

description: Application tracks the candidate funnel for a Job using a selected Resume. Status lifecycle is new -> draft_ready -> approved_for_submit -> submitted -> rejected/in_progress/completed.
title: Application

description: ApplicationQuestionResponse links draft or approved responses to a specific application.
title: Application question response link

description: JobInterviewStage stores expected interview stages for a job with order and stage type.
title: Job interview stage

description: Interview tracks a concrete interview instance for a job interview stage, including date, status, and result.
title: Interview

description: InterviewArtifact stores artifacts related to an Interview, such as audio, transcript, feedback, screen recording, source repository, or interview URL.
title: Interview artifact

description: Person stores contact details for recruiters, employees, interviewers, or other relevant people.
title: Person

description: InterviewPerson links people to interviews.
title: Interview person link

description: CompanyEmployee links people to companies with a role.
title: Company employee link

description: CompanyRecruiter links people to companies as recruiter contacts.
title: Company recruiter link

description: ApplicationArtifact stores artifacts related to an Application, such as outreach message, contact, or email inbox evidence. Status lifecycle depends on artifact type.
title: Application artifact

description: CompanyResearch stores structured research tasks for a company, such as employees, problem statement, products, or blog.
title: Company research

description: CompanyInsight stores durable insights extracted from research, linked to a company.
title: Company insight

description: Event stores append-only evidence of system actions. Event type includes fetch, application, application_submit, job, and interview. Source is a string and payload is JSON.
title: Event

description: Add a new Source for fetching recent jobs or companies. M0 assumes source data is deduped enough and does not solve cross-source deduplication.
title: Add new job/company source

description: Create a FetchRun for an enabled Source and emit an Event of type fetch.
title: Create fetch run for source

description: Execute a FetchRun using its adapter and update state until completed or failed. Handles happy path, adapter_not_found, invalid_source, retry_exhausted, and server_error.
title: Run fetch run until completion

description: Import skills from known seed JSON into Skill rows.
title: Add skills from seed JSON

description: Add structured resume JSON, extract known experience shape, persist resume, experiences, resume_experience links, and experience_skill links.
title: Add resume in JSON format

description: Research a Job to extract applicant questions and mentioned skills, then link them immediately to the Job. Emits job events when research starts and succeeds or fails.
title: Research job

description: Create an Application for a Job and Resume, draft question responses, link them immediately, and emit application events for creation, draft start, draft finish/failure, and ready-for-submit review.
title: Start application for job

description: Transition Application to approved_for_submit, then use job.apply_adapter and job.apply_url with resume/question context. M0 should implement a safe stub adapter unless a real adapter is explicitly requested and reviewed.
title: Submit application

intent: Repo records the Shore reference URL and SHA in docs or metadata.
title: Shore template reference is recorded

intent: Project declares Ruby 4.0.1 in version files and CI.
title: Ruby version is 4.0.1

intent: Gemfile resolves Rails 8.1.
title: Rails version is 8.1

intent: CI can run Ruby linting using StandardRB/RuboCop config.
title: StandardRB/RuboCop is configured

intent: RSpec and FactoryBot are installed, configured, and template references to Minitest are removed unless intentionally used for tiny unit tests.
title: RSpec and FactoryBot are default test stack

intent: Rails database config uses PostgreSQL for development and test.
title: PostgreSQL is configured

intent: Project can build and serve a minimal React/Inertia page through vite_rails using Bun.
title: React, Inertia, Vite, and Bun are configured

intent: Rails app includes Solid Queue, Solid Cache, and Solid Cable configuration.
title: Solid Queue/Cache/Cable are configured

intent: CI runs tests, linting, and security checks.
title: GitHub Actions runs checks

intent: docker compose reports healthy/running containers for web and required services.
title: Docker containers are healthy

intent: Compose config should avoid exposing app ports to host except through the external proxy network.
title: Containers are not reachable by direct host ports

intent: job-tracker.home.br11k.dev resolves locally and returns a successful HTTP response through Caddy.
title: Local hostname resolves and serves app

intent: Project documents how to verify the local hostname is not accessible from outside the LAN. Automated check may be deferred.
title: External access check is documented

intent: coherence-core-db --version prints coherence-core-db 0.2.0.
title: coherence-core-db version is 0.2.0

intent: coherence-core-db project catalog-preflight returns catalog-preflight: ok.
title: catalog-preflight is ok

intent: coherence-core-db db-ping returns db-ping: ok using socket.
title: db-ping socket is ok

intent: Each model spec has at least one RSpec example covering valid persistence and key validation/transition ACs.
title: Model validity is covered by RSpec

intent: FactoryBot defines valid factories for each model that can build and create records.
title: FactoryBot has valid factories

intent: Each spec/AC can be traced to at least one test file or explicitly marked manual/deferred.
title: Coherence specs map to test files

intent: Given valid Source attributes, a Source row is persisted in the selected DB engine.
title: System can persist valid Source

intent: Given an enabled Source, creating a fetch run persists a new FetchRun with status new and retry 0.
title: System can create FetchRun for enabled Source

intent: Invalid source type, adapter, or auth_mode must not persist.
title: System rejects invalid Source enums

intent: Given a valid source and company attributes, a Company row is persisted.
title: System can persist Company from Source

intent: Website and careers page URL should either be blank or parse as URLs.
title: Company URL fields are valid or blank

intent: Given valid resume JSON, the system persists the Resume and stores any provided PDF reference.
title: System can persist structured Resume

intent: A Resume cannot be created without structured JSON.
title: Resume JSON is required

intent: Given company name, title, description, and valid dates, an Experience row is persisted.
title: System can persist valid Experience

intent: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
title: Experience rejects impossible date range

intent: Given existing Resume and Experience rows, the system persists a link row.
title: System can link Resume to Experience

intent: The same resume_id and experience_id pair should not be duplicated.
title: System prevents duplicate ResumeExperience link

intent: Given a skill name and valid type, a Skill row is persisted.
title: System can persist valid Skill

intent: The same normalized skill should not be created twice.
title: System prevents duplicate normalized Skill

intent: Given existing Experience and Skill rows, the system persists a link row.
title: System can link Experience to Skill

intent: The same experience_id and skill_id pair should not be duplicated.
title: System prevents duplicate ExperienceSkill link

intent: Given an existing Experience and STAR fields, an ExperienceStory row is persisted.
title: System can persist ExperienceStory

intent: Action and result should be present because they are needed for useful application answers.
title: ExperienceStory requires action and result

intent: Given concern, text, and response_type, a Question row is persisted.
title: System can persist valid Question

intent: A Question cannot be persisted without text.
title: Question text is required

intent: Given a Question and response payload, a draft QuestionResponse is persisted.
title: System can persist draft QuestionResponse

intent: A response cannot transition to approved unless content is present.
title: Approved response requires content

intent: Given valid source, company, canonical_id, title, and apply_url, a Job row is persisted with status new.
title: System can persist new Job

intent: A Job cannot transition to skip without a skip_reason.
title: Skipped Job requires skip reason

intent: The same source_id and canonical_id pair should not create duplicate jobs.
title: canonical_id is unique per Source

intent: Given existing Job and Skill rows, the system persists a JobSkill row.
title: System can link Job to Skill

intent: If required is omitted, it defaults to false.
title: JobSkill required defaults to false

intent: Given existing Job and Question rows, the system persists a JobQuestion row.
title: System can link Job to Question

intent: The same job_id and question_id pair should not be duplicated.
title: System prevents duplicate JobQuestion link

intent: Given existing Job and Resume rows, the system persists an Application with status new.
title: System can create new Application

intent: Application status transitions must follow the declared lifecycle.
title: Application status transition is valid

intent: A job should not have multiple active application records in M0.
title: Only one active Application per Job

intent: Given existing Application and QuestionResponse rows, the system persists a link row.
title: System can link Application to QuestionResponse

intent: The same application_id and question_response_id pair should not be duplicated.
title: System prevents duplicate ApplicationQuestionResponse link

intent: Given a Job, order, and stage type, the system persists a JobInterviewStage row.
title: System can persist JobInterviewStage

intent: A job cannot have two interview stages with the same order.
title: Stage order is unique per Job

intent: Given an interview stage and date, the system persists an Interview with status new and result awaiting.
title: System can persist Interview

intent: When status is completed, result must be success or reject.
title: Completed Interview requires final result

intent: Given an Interview and artifact type/content, the system persists an InterviewArtifact row.
title: System can persist InterviewArtifact

intent: An artifact must include content JSON or a file/location reference.
title: InterviewArtifact content is required

intent: Given a name and optional contact fields, the system persists a Person row.
title: System can persist Person

intent: Email and URL-like fields must either be blank or valid.
title: Person contact fields are valid or blank

intent: Given existing Interview and Person rows, the system persists an InterviewPerson link.
title: System can link Person to Interview

intent: The same interview_id and person_id pair should not be duplicated.
title: System prevents duplicate InterviewPerson link

intent: Given existing Company and Person rows, the system persists a CompanyEmployee link with role.
title: System can link Person to Company as employee

intent: A CompanyEmployee row requires a role string.
title: CompanyEmployee role is required

intent: Given existing Company and Person rows, the system persists a CompanyRecruiter link.
title: System can link Person to Company as recruiter

intent: The same company_id and person_id pair should not be duplicated.
title: System prevents duplicate CompanyRecruiter link

intent: Given an Application and valid artifact type/content/status, the system persists an ApplicationArtifact row.
title: System can persist ApplicationArtifact

intent: Outreach messages must follow draft -> draft_accepted/draft_rejected -> processing -> message_sent -> waiting_response -> success/no_response.
title: Outreach message status transition is valid

intent: Given a Company and valid research type/status/content, the system persists a CompanyResearch row.
title: System can persist CompanyResearch

intent: Research status must follow draft -> in_progress -> review -> completed/rejected.
title: CompanyResearch status transition is valid

intent: Given a Company and insight content, the system persists a CompanyInsight row.
title: System can persist CompanyInsight

intent: An insight row cannot be persisted without content JSON.
title: CompanyInsight content is required

intent: Given event type, source, payload, and timestamp, the system appends an Event row.
title: System can append Event

intent: Existing events should not be updated or destroyed through normal application flows.
title: Events are append-only

intent: Event timestamps are stored in UTC and serialized as ISO 8601.
title: Event timestamp is UTC ISO 8601

intent: Given type, base_url, adapter, auth_mode, and enabled, the system creates exactly one Source row.
title: System can create and store new valid Source

intent: If source attributes are invalid, no Source row is created.
title: Invalid Source is not persisted

intent: Given an enabled Source, system creates +1 FetchRun with status new and +1 Event type fetch.
title: System creates FetchRun for enabled Source

intent: Given a disabled Source, no FetchRun is created and an error event can be emitted.
title: Disabled Source does not create FetchRun

intent: Given valid adapter output, system creates company/job rows, updates FetchRun on workflow steps, and emits a final fetch event.
title: Happy path imports jobs and companies

intent: If adapter cannot be resolved, FetchRun becomes failed and event.payload contains error message.
title: adapter_not_found fails FetchRun

intent: If source is invalid for adapter, FetchRun becomes failed and event.payload contains error message.
title: invalid_source fails FetchRun

intent: If retries exceed max 3, FetchRun becomes failed and event.payload includes retry evidence.
title: retry_exhausted fails FetchRun

intent: Server errors are captured in FetchRun content and event payload.
title: server_error records failure evidence

intent: Given valid seed JSON, system creates +x Skill rows.
title: System creates Skill rows from seed

intent: Running the same seed twice does not create duplicate normalized skills.
title: Skill seed import is idempotent

intent: Given valid resume JSON, system creates +1 Resume, +x Experience, +x ResumeExperience, and +x ExperienceSkill rows.
title: System creates Resume and extracted experience graph

intent: If resume JSON does not match the expected shape, no partial resume graph is persisted.
title: Invalid resume JSON rolls back

intent: Given a Job description/application page snapshot, system creates +x Question, +x JobQuestion, and +x JobSkill rows.
title: System extracts questions and skills from Job

intent: Job research emits one event when started and one event when succeeded or failed.
title: Research emits start and finish events

intent: Given Job, Resume, and linked JobQuestions, system creates +1 Application, +x draft QuestionResponse, and +x ApplicationQuestionResponse rows.
title: System creates Application and draft responses

intent: System emits events for application record creation, draft start, draft success/failure, and ready-for-submit review.
title: Start application emits lifecycle events

intent: Given an Application approved for submit, system runs apply adapter and emits application_submit start/finish/failure events.
title: Approved Application can run apply adapter

intent: Application must not run submit adapter before approved_for_submit.
title: Unapproved Application cannot be submitted

intent: In M0, the default apply adapter records intended payload/evidence without submitting to external systems.
title: M0 submit adapter is safe stub
